prompt: Research one AI-native drug-discovery platform investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Automated labs, proprietary biological and chemical datasets, foundation models, and computational chemistry may compress target and molecule discovery while pharma productivity pressure increases partnership demand.
inputs.drivers: Pharma patent cliffs; platform funding and M&A; compute and wet-lab co-innovation; FDA AI credibility framework; multimodal data; computational chemistry; antibody discovery; licensing economics.
inputs.value_chain: Accelerated compute and software; proprietary datasets; automated labs; RXRX, SDGR, ABCL, and TEM-like platforms; large-pharma customers; legacy CRO and research-model substitutes.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires clinical or partnership readouts to show cycle-time or success-rate gains and material milestones, platform revenue, pipeline value, or M&A optionality.
inputs.invalidation: Clinical translation remains unproven, cash burn and dilution dominate, pharma captures economics, wet-lab and regulatory validation stay slow, or platform revenue remains lumpy.
